entities.summary: St. Mary the Consoler at Tiburtino is a Roman Catholic titular parish church in Rome. It is located in Piazza Santa Maria Consolatrice, within the quartiere Tiburtino. Santa Maria Consolatrice al Tiburtino is a church building in Europe, established in 1945-07-14. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
